title: Tolleson General Engineering Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary engineering services for the City of Tolleson across several technical disciplines.
project_scope: On-call general engineering services for the City of Tolleson covering multiple disciplines, including architectural services, transportation engineering, surveying, traffic engineering, general civil engineering, plan review and inspections, geotechnical services, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and planning/master planning. The notice indicates multiple contracts will be awarded under a base period of 12 months with renewal options up to 48 additional months.
services: General engineering on-call services; architecture; civil engineering; structural engineering; transportation and traffic engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; geotechnical engineering; inspection services; planning/master planning; electrical and mechanical engineering; plan review/inspections.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services across many disciplines without a defined structural project.
- Includes structural engineering, but no specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or complex building scope is described.
- Multiple-award general services contract is less attractive for sbp, especially without technical specification.
- Significant portions of the scope are outside sbp's core focus, such as geotechnical, surveying, inspections, MEP, and general civil services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. This is an on-call professional services procurement with no defined project size, building area, span, or construction budget, so no realistic estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a multi-discipline on-call services contract with undefined task orders and multiple awards, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from qualified professional engineering firms for general engineering on-call services across the listed disciplines. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are provided in the source text.
contracting_authority: City of Tolleson, Tolleson, Arizona, USA. Contact: Deanna Graham. Phone: 623-936-7111. Fax: 623-936-7117. Email: deanna.graham@tolleson.az.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/tollesonaz/projects/263456/downloads
notes: Project number DS26-01. Solicitation stage: RFP/RFQ. Questions deadline: 2026-08-06 04:00 PM MST. Multiple contracts will be awarded. Contract duration: base period 12 months, renewable with 48 months of renewal options. Although structural engineering is listed, the notice is primarily a broad municipal on-call framework without a defined building or structure.
